name: Flight 5
summary: Booster 12 became the first Super Heavy caught by the launch tower's chopstick arms, returning to OLP-1 about 7 minutes after liftoff. Ship 30 reentered with only minor flap damage and made a precise controlled splashdown next to a pre-positioned buoy in the Indian Ocean about 65 minutes after launch. The ship was not meant to be recovered and exploded about 16 seconds after hitting the water.
highlights: First Super Heavy caught by the launch tower
Booster returned to OLP-1 at T+6:54
Ship splashdown filmed by a pre-positioned buoy
Only minor flap damage during reentry
FAA license issued the day before launch

objectives.label: Ship reentry and controlled splashdown on target

boosterFate: Caught by the OLP-1 tower chopsticks at T+6:54. Later retired.
shipFate: Controlled splashdown in the Indian Ocean at T+1:05:40, then exploded after hitting the water.
